$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — AQ96 (CE-2319/2320): a lone man under steady fire. Judge (1) after the first near miss he is never upright (stance intent never Standing from 1 s after it, until the fire stops), (2) the near miss drops him prone (UnderFireMove.Phase Down/Shifting/Crawling; stance Prone), (3) pinned he stays down (never Moving until the fire stops), (4) both hostiles run dry at 15 s (as the live check: WeaponState.Ammo 0), then he rises (Moving) 2.5-8 s later (the live check's window) and rushes on crouched. NOT expressible: the speeds (~3 m/s rush), the ~1.5 m side step, (5) 'no second drop within 3 s of rising'. UNVERIFIED: RecentSenses/UnderFireMove/StanceIntent are brain-local components — assumed present in the editor world's entity dump (the old live check read them over /entities).
